news.author: Mark Bowman

news.title: 'It's like a light switch went on': The inside story of Pete Crow-Armstrong's MVP-worthy season
news.summary: The Cubs' star center fielder hit another level midway through the 2026 season. Here's what shaped PCA's superstar turn.

news.title: Braves bolster bullpen, reach 3-year, $35 million deal with Phillips
news.summary: The Braves and free agent relief pitcher Evan Phillips, who appeared in 31 games for the Dodgers last season, have agreed to a three-year, $35 million contract.

news.title: Brewers' Misiorowski, Yanks' Schlittler crowned unanimous Cy Young winners
news.summary: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski and New York's Cam Schlittler capped dominant 2026 seasons by sweeping all 30 first-place votes to win their respective Cy Young Awards.

news.title: Former catcher Ausmus lands Astros manager job, 'can't wait to get to work'
news.summary: The Astros are hiring Yankees bench coach Brad Ausmus, who played 10 of his 18 MLB seasons as a catcher in Houston, as the team's new manager.

news.title: Nationals, OF Young agree on 4-year deal with '31 option
news.summary: Outfielder Jacob Young has agreed to a four-year contract with the Nationals, a deal that also includes a team option for 2031.

news.title: Brewers' Murphy 3-peats as top NL manager; White Sox's Venable wins AL honors
news.summary: The Brewers' Pat Murphy became the first to win NL Manager of the Year in three straight seasons Tuesday, while Will Venable of the White Sox won AL honors.

news.title: Source: Tigers agree to 1-year deal with reliever Pagan
news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have agreed to a one-year deal with reliever Emilio Pagan, a source confirmed to ESPN.
